name: 30MC Young Gun Championship
epitaph: Unified from two old Young Guns belts on the promotion's first card and changed hands four times across its served run, ending with a champion counted out of the ring in a finish the broadcast itself never explains, and a belt burned on camera the same night.

name: 30MC Television Championship
epitaph: Created by decree on the promotion's first card out of two dissolved Hard Knocks Wrestling belts, and changed hands twice across its served run -- once on a mystery referee's fast count, once retrieved off a ladder.
